status: local regression, Clippy and release measurements pass; native matrix pending
defect: Bun and Go could report a technical fault before asynchronous/delayed Session.close completed, allowing the managing executor to kill the process first. Protocol parse faults did not schedule session cleanup.
change: Await/complete session cleanup before fault publication; serialize protocol cleanup with session execution; release pending collaborator calls before queued cleanup. Go cleanup panic becomes a technical error.
regressions: Both new delayed-close probes fail on the previous helpers and pass after the fix. Go also checks close panic; Bun checks preservation of cleanup failure. Normal, EOF and mock-transport conformance remains covered.
native_acceptance: Both SDK cleanup probes now run in every required host job. Bun helper coverage/packet reports are archived separately from Rust core coverage. Optional RSS remains null on unsupported hosts.
